messages.text: Hi, I returned the glass kettle. Will the shipping I paid be refunded too, or just the kettle?

The kettle refund covers what you paid for the item after discounts, not shipping (refund-policy/v2/amount). Shipping isn’t refunded automatically; a request to refund it needs staff review (refund-policy/v2/shipping).
